cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Manager, Lab Operations – Microbiology to join our team at [Company name masked]. This people manager will oversee a team of 3 direct reports, 6 MSAT and 14 Bioproduction employees. MSAT works to develop and implement modern processes and technology in support of manufacturing microbiology products (Bacteriology, Protistology, Mycology, and Molecular biology). The manager is also responsible for project management and technical oversight of MSAT activities.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Operations: Support the production operations in a manufacturing environment with oversight of Microbiology Production including Bacteriology, Protistology, Mycology, and Molecular biology.
Personnel Management: Develop personnel with the right skillset and commitment to meet quality system requirements, provide a positive, engaged work culture while maintaining accountability to meet goals, budgets, milestones, and other metrics.
Process Improvement: Provide manufacturing scale up and efficiencies to production process.
Resource Utilization: Effective management of materials, equipment, and staff to produce quality products.
Quality and Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring compliance with manufacturing and documentation guidelines and collaborating effectively in technology transfer while maintaining quality, regulatory, and ISO compliance in all aspects of production work.
Document Management: Strong skills in preparing and reviewing documentation, including reports, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and departmental policies and protocols as needed.

Bachelor's degree and 7 or more years of relevant experience, including 2 or more years of supervisory experience or equivalent experience.
Technical Microbiology skills including microbial cultivation, preferably of a broad range of organisms, aseptic techniques, and identification and sensitivity testing.
Instrumentation experience including PCR, incubators, microscopes, and bacterial enumeration.

Experience with bioreactors, anaerobe chambers and/or preservation techniques.
Prior experience in a biomaterials manufacturing or production environment.

MSAT develops and implements processes and technology to support manufacturing of microbiology products (Bacteriology, Protistology, Mycology, and Molecular biology). The role also covers project management and technical oversight of MSAT activities.
cond_0169.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Operations: Support production operations with oversight of Microbiology Production including Bacteriology, Protistology, Mycology, and Molecular biology.
Personnel Management: Develop personnel with the right skillset and commitment to meet quality system requirements, maintain accountability to goals, budgets, milestones, and other metrics, and support a positive work culture.
Process Improvement: Provide manufacturing scale-up and efficiencies to the production process.
Resource Utilization: Manage materials, equipment, and staff to produce quality products.
Quality and Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with manufacturing and documentation guidelines, and coordinate with relevant teams on technology transfer while maintaining quality, regulatory, and ISO compliance across production work.
Document Management: Prepare and review documentation including reports, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and departmental policies and protocols as needed.
Problem-Solving and Root Cause Analysis: Lead root cause analysis and investigations of non-conformances, implement corrective actions, and oversee defect resolution and related documentation and records maintenance.
cond_0169.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree and 7 or more years of relevant experience, including 2 or more years of supervisory experience or equivalent.
Technical Microbiology skills including microbial cultivation, aseptic techniques, and identification and sensitivity testing.
Instrumentation experience including PCR, incubators, microscopes, and bacterial enumeration.
Preferred Requirements
Microbial cultivation experience across a broad range of organisms.
Experience with bioreactors, anaerobe chambers, and/or preservation techniques.
Prior experience in a biomaterials manufacturing or production environment.
Experience transferring microbiology products from R&D into manufacturing.

This people manager will oversee a team of 3 direct reports, 6 MSAT and 14 Bioproduction employees. MSAT works to develop and implement modern processes and technology in support of manufacturing microbiology products (Bacteriology, Protistology, Mycology, and Molecular biology). The manager is also responsible for project management and technical oversight of MSAT activities. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of microbiology manufacturing processes and how they connect to quality and production outcomes.
cond_0292.responsibilities: Manufacturing Operations: Support the production operations in a manufacturing environment with oversight of Microbiology Production including Bacteriology, Protistology, Mycology, and Molecular biology. Personnel Management: Develop personnel with the right skillset and commitment to meet quality system requirements, provide a positive, engaged work culture while maintaining accountability to meet goals, budgets, milestones, and other metrics. Process Improvement: Provide manufacturing scale up and efficiencies to production process. Resource Utilization: Effective management of materials, equipment, and staff to produce quality products. Quality and Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring compliance with manufacturing and documentation guidelines and collaborating effectively in technology transfer while maintaining quality, regulatory, and ISO compliance in all aspects of production work. Document Management: Strong skills in preparing and reviewing documentation, including reports, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and departmental policies and protocols as needed. Problem-Solving and Root Cause Analysis: Proficiency in leading root cause analysis and investigations of non-conformances, implementing corrective actions, and overseeing defect resolution and related documentation and records maintenance.
cond_0292.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree and 7 or more years of relevant experience, including 2 or more years of supervisory experience or equivalent experience.
Technical Microbiology skills including microbial cultivation, preferably of a broad range of organisms, aseptic techniques, and identification and sensitivity testing.
Instrumentation experience including PCR, incubators, microscopes, and bacterial enumeration.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with bioreactors, anaerobe chambers and/or preservation techniques.
Prior experience in a biomaterials manufacturing or production environment.

cond_0331.intro: We are looking for a Manager, Lab Operations – Microbiology to join our team at [Company name masked]. This role manages the Microbiology production and Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) departments, with oversight of 3 direct reports, 6 MSAT employees, and 14 Bioproduction employees. The role also covers project management and technical oversight of MSAT activities.
cond_0331.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Operations: Support production operations with oversight of Microbiology Production including Bacteriology, Protistology, Mycology, and Molecular biology.
Personnel Management: Develop personnel with the right skillset and commitment to meet quality system requirements, maintain accountability to goals, budgets, milestones, and other metrics, and support a positive work culture.
Process Improvement: Provide manufacturing scale-up and efficiencies to the production process.
Resource Utilization: Manage materials, equipment, and staff to produce quality products.
Quality and Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with manufacturing and documentation guidelines, and coordinate with relevant teams on technology transfer while maintaining quality, regulatory, and ISO compliance across production work.
Document Management: Prepare and review documentation including reports, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and departmental policies and protocols as needed.

Bachelor's degree and 7 or more years of relevant experience, including 2 or more years of supervisory experience or equivalent.
Technical Microbiology skills including microbial cultivation, aseptic techniques, and identification and sensitivity testing.
Instrumentation experience including PCR, incubators, microscopes, and bacterial enumeration.
Preferred Requirements
Microbial cultivation experience across a broad range of organisms.
Experience with bioreactors, anaerobe chambers, and/or preservation techniques.
Prior experience in a biomaterials manufacturing or production environment.
Experience transferring microbiology products from R&D into manufacturing.

This people manager will oversee a team of 3 direct reports, 6 MSAT and 14 Bioproduction employees, staying in regular contact with staff across Microbiology production and Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) departments. MSAT works to develop and implement modern processes and technology in support of manufacturing microbiology products (Bacteriology, Protistology, Mycology, and Molecular biology). The manager is also responsible for project management and technical oversight of MSAT activities. This role requires prior leadership and manufacturing experience. Preferred experience includes transferring microbiology products from R&D into manufacturing.
cond_0519.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Operations: Stay closely connected with production operations in a manufacturing environment, with oversight of Microbiology Production including Bacteriology, Protistology, Mycology, and Molecular biology.
Personnel Management: Develop personnel with the right skillset and commitment to meet quality system requirements, actively foster a positive, engaged work culture while maintaining accountability to meet goals, budgets, milestones, and other metrics.
Process Improvement: Initiate and communicate manufacturing scale up and efficiencies to the production process.
Resource Utilization: Effective management of materials, equipment, and staff to produce quality products.
Quality and Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring compliance with manufacturing and documentation guidelines and collaborating regularly and directly with teams on technology transfer while maintaining quality, regulatory, and ISO compliance in all aspects of production work.
Document Management: Strong skills in preparing and reviewing documentation, including reports, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and departmental policies and protocols as needed.
Problem-Solving and Root Cause Analysis: Proficiency in leading root cause analysis and investigations of non-conformances, speaking up early to initiate corrective actions, and overseeing defect resolution and related documentation and records maintenance.
cond_0519.requirements:
Bachelor's degree and 7 or more years of relevant experience, including 2 or more years of supervisory experience or equivalent experience.
Technical Microbiology skills including microbial cultivation, preferrably of a broad range of organisms, aseptic techniques, and identification and sensitivity testing.
Instrumentation experience including PCR, incubators, microscopes, and bacterial enumeration.
Experience with bioreactors, anaerobe chambers and/or preservation techniques is a plus.
Prior experience in a biomaterials manufacturing or production environment highly preferred.
cond_0519.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0559.intro: We are looking for a Manager, Lab Operations – Microbiology to join our team at [Company name masked]. This people manager will oversee a team of 3 direct reports, 6 MSAT and 14 Bioproduction employees. MSAT works to develop and implement modern processes and technology in support of manufacturing microbiology products (Bacteriology, Protistology, Mycology, and Molecular biology). The manager is also responsible for project management and technical oversight of MSAT activities.
cond_0559.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Operations: Support the production operations in a manufacturing environment with oversight of Microbiology Production including Bacteriology, Protistology, Mycology, and Molecular biology.
Personnel Management: Develop personnel with the right skillset and commitment to meet quality system requirements, provide a positive, engaged work culture while maintaining accountability to meet goals, budgets, milestones, and other metrics.
Process Improvement: Provide manufacturing scale up and efficiencies to production process.
Resource Utilization: Effective management of materials, equipment, and staff to produce quality products.
Quality and Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring compliance with manufacturing and documentation guidelines and collaborating effectively in technology transfer while maintaining quality, regulatory, and ISO compliance in all aspects of production work.
Document Management: Strong skills in preparing and reviewing documentation, including reports, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and departmental policies and protocols as needed.
Problem-Solving and Root Cause Analysis: Proficiency in leading root cause analysis and investigations of non-conformances, implementing corrective actions, and overseeing defect resolution and related documentation and records maintenance.
cond_0559.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree and 7 or more years of relevant experience, including 2 or more years of supervisory experience or equivalent experience.
Technical Microbiology skills including microbial cultivation, preferably of a broad range of organisms, aseptic techniques, and identification and sensitivity testing.
Instrumentation experience including PCR, incubators, microscopes, and bacterial enumeration.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with bioreactors, anaerobe chambers and/or preservation techniques.
Prior experience in a biomaterials manufacturing or production environment.
